customManagers.description: The Grafana plugins that Grafana preinstalls, pinned as <id>@<version> in the plugins value (#2022).

packageRules.description: The Style Dictionary lock is no entry of tools.lock, so Renovate updates it (docs/DESIGN.md, Token pipeline). The CI job Design Tokens fails when the new version changes a built token file.
Renovate reads an Application source with no chart as a git dependency. Argo CD tracks main on purpose (ADR 0013), so those dependencies stay off.

Each Grafana plugin release names the Grafana it needs as grafanaDependency, which Renovate cannot read. A minor release can need a newer Grafana minor, so each plugin gets its own pull request, held to the major that the running Grafana major needs.
prBodyNotes: Before the merge, check that the Grafana image of the `grafana` chart meets the `grafanaDependency` of this release: https://grafana.com/api/plugins/{{{depName}}}/versions/{{{newVersion}}}. Grafana installs the pinned version at start.

packageRules.description: SearXNG publishes many tags a day, and the tests hold the engine names of the pinned image. A tag has no minimum release age (CONTRIBUTING.md, Dependency Versions), so a person refreshes the engine names at each bump.
prBodyNotes: Before the merge, follow the bump steps in `k8s/README.md`, section SearXNG: refresh `tests/fixtures/searxng/default_engine_names.txt` from the new image and read its notes on the engines that the settings keep.

packageRules.description: A base image update of the service image is a fix, so release-please releases it. Other updates stay chore and release nothing alone.
